product: Aqua Bomb PHA Exfoliating Toner Pads

reviews.headline: Super duper wet
reviews.comment: I've used exfoliating pads for years and wanted to try these. I love them but did I get a messed up batch or what? Mine are literally floating in liquid. They look like someone poured a cup of water in there, so much so that when I peeled off the foil when opening them, I spilled the liquid all over my shirt.

reviews.headline: Perfect for sensitive skin!
reviews.comment: I love these toner pads!! They're exfloiating yet still gentle on the skin. They've made my skin texture improve greatly!!

reviews.headline: The Perfect Toning Pads
reviews.comment: Love everything about these toning pads. They gently exfoliate without irritating my skin and they leave my skin looking fresh and hydrated.

reviews.headline: Can't be without these for too long
reviews.comment: Belif discontinued these for a period of time and I wasn't able to replace them once I ran out. I scoured the internet for a backup supply because they are really that good. My skin doesn't tolerate many products well and it's on the dry side, so I wasn't expecting these to really be all that moisturizing. They really are though, and they give skin this beautiful glass glow. My skin loved them and they helped keep it clear and smooth. definite HG, the only product from them I really feel makes a difference.
